# Manta Maestro — Comprehensive Test Suite Specification

**Version**: 1.0.0
**Target system**: Manta Maestro v4.2 (20 agentes, 3 eixos) → Phase 2/3 roadmap
**Prepared for**: maestro-testing team
**Date**: 2026-07-25
**Source of truth**: `CLAUDE.md` (master registry v4.2), `tests/routing/prompts.md`, `tests/routing/test_multiagent_dispatch.md`, `docs/PHASE-2-ROADMAP.md`, `docs/PHASE-3-ROADMAP.md`, `docs/MONITORING-MAESTRO.md`, `docs/RUNBOOK-PHASE-2.4-RAG-DEPLOYMENT.md`, `.claude/agents/*.md`

> **Provenance note**: This specification consolidates test scenarios grounded in the artifacts that actually exist in the `Codex-exemplo` repository today (routing rules, existing smoke tests, roadmap deliverables, monitoring schema). Where the repository does not yet contain a concrete artifact (e.g. live latency numbers, a deployed regulatory webhook), the corresponding test is marked **`[PLANNED]`** with the Phase/date it targets, and any illustrative numbers are marked **`(synthetic fixture)`** — not a claim about a real production measurement. Regulatory excerpts used in Category D are synthetic paraphrases built for fixture purposes, never verbatim citations of real ANEEL/ANTAQ/ANA/ANAC text — treat them as structural test data only, and swap in real excerpts before using this suite against a production RAG index.

---

## 1. Executive Summary

Manta Maestro routes user queries across **20 agentes** on two axes — 11 horizontais (Manta 00–16) and 9 verticais (S1–S10, com S5 coberto por S2+S4) — plus an 8-phase lifecycle axis. The `v4.2` expansion (2026-07-05) added 5 new verticais (S6 Portos, S7 Aeroportos, S8 Saneamento, S9 Energia, S10 Barragens), 5 RAG collections, and 5 SharePoint routing folders — all still carrying open items on the `DEPLOY CHECKLIST v4.2` (RAG collections not yet created, routing rules not yet inserted, MN gate not yet passed).

This document defines the **regression + validation test suite** the maestro-testing team runs before promoting v4.2 (and the in-flight Phase 2/Phase 3 features) from "operational on paper" to "operational in production." It is organized into 5 test categories, each with 6 batches of 5 tests (30 tests/category, **150 tests total**):

| # | Category | Validates | Primary phase |
|---|----------|-----------|----------------|
| A | Routing scenarios | Maestro (Manta 00) dispatch correctness | Phase 1 (core) + Phase 2.2 (orchestration) |
| B | Performance benchmarks | Latency/token/cost SLOs | Phase 1.4 (monitoring) |
| C | RAG validation queries | Retrieval correctness per collection | Phase 2.4 (RAG ingestion) |
| D | Regulatory document samples | Auto-classification + webhook ingestion | Phase 2.3 + Phase 3.2 |
| E | User feedback patterns | Feedback loop → keyword learning | Phase 2.1 |

**Current readiness (per DEPLOY CHECKLIST v4.2 in `CLAUDE.md`)**: 2/10 items done. The suite below is written to be runnable in stages as each checklist item lands — most Category C and D tests will report `BLOCKED` (not `FAIL`) until the RAG collections and routing rules referenced in `CLAUDE.md` are actually created in Supabase.

## 11. Failure Modes & Debugging Tips

| Symptom | Likely cause | Debug steps |
|---------|--------------|--------------|
| Every Category C test returns `BLOCKED` | RAG collections not created in Supabase (DEPLOY CHECKLIST item open) | `supabase db query "SELECT collection_slug, COUNT(*) FROM rag_chunks GROUP BY 1;"` — if 0 rows, run `docs/RUNBOOK-PHASE-2.4-RAG-DEPLOYMENT.md` first |
| Batch A5 (high-confidence) intermittently triggers orchestration | Score-gap threshold miscalibrated, or keyword weights drifted from `maestro_routing_keywords` seed | Compare live scores against `CLAUDE.md` routing rules; check `maestro_routing_keywords` for unreviewed auto-adjustments from Phase 2.1 learning loop |
| Batch A3 (ambiguous) fails to invoke orchestrator | `maestro-orchestrator.md` (Manta 16) not wired into router, or `orchestrator.py` still pending (see PHASE-2-ROADMAP 2.2 "pending integration") | Check router dispatch logs for `orchestrator_invoked=false` where expected `true`; confirm `manta-hub/maestro/orchestrator.py` exists and is called |
| Latency (B1) spikes only on `agente-energia` | Tier misassignment — check if Sonnet/Opus tier is being used where Haiku would suffice | Query `maestro_metrics_daily` tier distribution for that agent; compare against MONITORING alert "Opus Usage > 30%" |
| Regulatory fixture (D5.1, impersonation) "passes" without any warning | Pipeline has no provenance verification (documented known gap) | Do not treat a silent pass as a security clearance — this must be a standing manual-review control, tracked outside the automated suite |
| Cross-collection query (C6) returns only one collection's results | `collection_slug` filter applied too early in the retrieval query, or embedding search not fanned out across collections | Inspect the RAG query builder; confirm it unions across collections before ranking, not after truncating to top-k per collection |
| Feedback loop (E1–E2) inserts logged but `approval_rate` unchanged | `analyze_feedback_and_recommend()` job not scheduled, or materialized view stale | Check `maestro_feedback_analysis` last-updated timestamp; confirm weekly job (Phase 2.1 checklist) is actually running, not just defined |
| Orchestrated merge (A6) omits required cross-concerns | Merge prompt to Manta 16 not including both agents' full responses, or truncated context window | Inspect `merged_response` input construction; verify `primary_response`/`secondary_response` are passed uncut per `orchestrator.py` pseudocode |
| Hallucinated-citation report (E6.2) has no escalation path | aluci-guard-class governance not wired to the runtime feedback pipeline | Confirm the `aluci-guard` skill (or equivalent runtime check) runs on agent output before it reaches the user, not only on manually-invoked audits |

## 13. CI/CD Integration Guidance

### Trigger strategy

| Category | Trigger | Rationale |
|----------|---------|-----------|
| A (routing) | Every PR touching `CLAUDE.md` or `.claude/agents/**` | Routing rules and agent definitions directly gate these tests |
| B (performance) | Nightly cron + manual pre-release | Needs steady-state traffic; not meaningful per-PR |
| C (RAG) | On `docs/rag-sources/**` change + after `ingest_rag_batch.py` runs | Validates ingestion didn't regress retrieval |
| D (regulatory) | On `scripts/regulatory_webhook_listener.py` change + weekly fixture replay | Guards the Phase 3.2 pipeline once live |
| E (feedback) | On `supabase/migrations/**feedback**` change + weekly | Validates schema + downstream learning-loop effects |

### Suggested workflow (extends the existing sync workflows referenced in PHASE-2/3 roadmaps)

```yaml
# .github/workflows/maestro-test-suite.yml
name: Manta Maestro Test Suite

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'CLAUDE.md'
      - '.claude/agents/**'
      - 'tests/routing/**'
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 3 * * *'   # nightly full run (Categories A-E)
  workflow_dispatch: {}

jobs:
  routing-scenarios:
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event_name == 'schedule'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Run Category A (routing scenarios)
        run: python scripts/test_routing.py tests/routing/prompts.md --json-out results/category-a.json
      - name: Run Category A6 (orchestration)
        run: python scripts/test_multiagent_dispatch.py tests/routing/test_multiagent_dispatch.md --json-out results/category-a6.json
      - name: Fail on regression vs previous tagged CLAUDE.md version
        run: python scripts/compare_routing_regression.py results/category-a.json baselines/last-release.json

  performance-benchmarks:
    if: github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Run Category B against staging
        run: python scripts/run_perf_benchmarks.py --env staging --json-out results/category-b.json
      - name: Push metrics to Supabase
        run: python scripts/push_test_results.py results/category-b.json --table maestro_test_suite_runs

  rag-validation:
    if: contains(github.event.pull_request.changed_files, 'docs/rag-sources') || github.event_name == 'schedule'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Run Category C (per-collection smoke queries)
        run: python scripts/test_rag_queries.py tests/rag/queries.md --json-out results/category-c.json

  regulatory-fixtures:
    if: github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Run Category D fixtures (dry-run mode against synthetic docs)
        run: python scripts/regulatory_webhook_listener.py --dry-run --fixtures tests/regulatory/fixtures/ --json-out results/category-d.json

  feedback-loop:
    if: github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Run Category E (feedback pattern replay)
        run: python scripts/test_feedback_patterns.py tests/feedback/patterns.md --json-out results/category-e.json

  publish-dashboard:
    needs: [routing-scenarios, performance-benchmarks, rag-validation, regulatory-fixtures, feedback-loop]
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Aggregate + publish to Cowork dashboard
        run: python scripts/publish_test_dashboard.py results/*.json
      - name: Notify Slack on any FAIL (not BLOCKED)
        if: failure()
        run: python scripts/notify_slack.py --webhook "${{ secrets.SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL }}" --severity fail-only
```

### Notes on scripts referenced but not yet in-repo

The workflow above references several scripts (`test_routing.py`, `compare_routing_regression.py`, `run_perf_benchmarks.py`, `push_test_results.py`, `test_rag_queries.py`, `test_feedback_patterns.py`, `publish_test_dashboard.py`, `notify_slack.py`) that **do not yet exist in this repository** — `tests/routing/prompts.md` itself notes "(script a ser criado no repo operacional do Maestro; por ora este arquivo serve como fonte manual para QA humano)". Treat the YAML above as the **target CI shape** to build toward, not a drop-in file; the only scripts confirmed to exist per the roadmaps are `scripts/ingest_rag_batch.py`, `scripts/sync_agents_to_sharepoint.py`, and (referenced, pending) `manta-hub/maestro/orchestrator.py`.

### Gating rules

- **Merge-blocking**: Category A regressions on PRs touching `CLAUDE.md`/`.claude/agents/**`.
- **Non-blocking but alerting**: Categories B, C, D, E on the nightly schedule — file GitHub issues, don't block unrelated PRs.
- **Human gate**: Per `CLAUDE.md` DEPLOY CHECKLIST v4.2, no release proceeds without "Gate humano: aprovação MN antes de merge" regardless of automated suite status.
